description: Source code for the Png class in the PDFsharp library, handling PNG image processing including opening images from streams, bytes, and files, and accessing image properties.

classes.name: Png
classes.description: Represents a PNG image, providing methods to open images from various sources and access image properties such as dimensions and pixel data.

methods.name: GetPixelIndex
methods.description: Returns the palette index at specified (x, y) coordinates.

methods.name: GetPalette
methods.description: Returns the color palette associated with the PNG image.

methods.name: GetPixel
methods.description: Returns the pixel data at specified (x, y) coordinates.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Static methods to open PNG images from streams, byte arrays, or file paths with optional settings or chunk visitors.
